```{python}
# read in county data
counties_df = client.query("SELECT CO_FIPS, CO_NAME FROM `wfrc-modeling-data.prd_boundary.county_geo`").to_dataframe()
counties_df['County'] = counties_df['CO_NAME'].str.title()
if debug: display(counties_df)
```

```{python}
# Modeled trip-end productions by county x purpose, one calibration run at a
# time -- see report/preprocess/tripgen.py (extracted so this parsing
# happens once per tdmcalib run/import, not on every `quarto render`; see
# report/README.md's "Report data caching" section). Reads
# runs/{calib_run}/cache/modeled_tripgen.parquet per run and concatenates
# with a 'calib_run' column, same contract load_per_run() used to have.
mod_p_se_county_reg_df = vs.load_cached_per_run(repo_root, "modeled_tripgen")

# County *names* + 'Data Source' are added here rather than cached (see
# report/preprocess/tripgen.py's docstring) -- CO_FIPS is null on the
# preprocessed 'Region' total row, which becomes the 'Region' label here.
# Cast to pandas' nullable Int64 (matching counties_df['CO_FIPS'], which
# BigQuery's to_dataframe() already returns as nullable Int64) -- the cache
# round-trip left this as plain float64 (introducing the null upcast a
# plain int dtype can't hold), and merging float64 against nullable Int64
# directly raises ("Cannot interpret 'Int64Dtype()' as a data type").
mod_p_se_county_reg_df['CO_FIPS'] = mod_p_se_county_reg_df['CO_FIPS'].astype('Int64')
mod_p_se_county_reg_df = mod_p_se_county_reg_df.merge(
    counties_df[['CO_FIPS', 'County']], on='CO_FIPS', how='left'
)
mod_p_se_county_reg_df['County'] = mod_p_se_county_reg_df['County'].fillna('Region')
mod_p_se_county_reg_df = mod_p_se_county_reg_df.drop(columns=['CO_FIPS'])
mod_p_se_county_reg_df['Data Source'] = nameMod
```

```{python}
# household travel survey (hts) data from bigquery
# union multiple sources to get single table for ease of queries
# make sure each year field names translate to same resulting names

hts_hh_df = client.query("""
  SELECT
    2023                          AS hts_year,
    CAST(hh_id AS STRING)         AS hh_id,
    hh_weight                     AS hh_weight,
    CAST(taz_v4.CO_TAZID AS INT)  AS hCO_TAZID,
    CAST(taz_v4.CO_FIPS AS INT)   AS hCO_FIPS,
    CAST(taz_v4.SUBAREAID AS INT) AS hSAID
  FROM `wfrc-modeling-data.prd_tdm_hts_2023.hh` AS hh
  JOIN `wfrc-modeling-data.prd_tdm_taz.ustm_v4_taz_2025_07_29_geo_enhanced` AS taz_v4
    ON hh.hCO_TAZID_USTMv4 = taz_v4.CO_TAZID
  WHERE hh_weight > 0

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    2012                          AS hts_year,
    password                      AS hh_id,
    weight                        AS hh_weight,
    CAST(taz_v3.CO_TAZID AS INT)  AS hCO_TAZID,
    CAST(taz_v3.CO_FIPS AS INT)   AS hCO_FIPS,
    CAST(taz_v3.SUBAREAID AS INT) AS hSAID
  FROM `wfrc-modeling-data.prd_tdm_hts_2012.household` AS hh
  JOIN `wfrc-modeling-data.prd_tdm_taz.ustm_v3_taz_2021_09_22_geo` AS taz_v3
    ON hh.h_CoTAZID_v30 = taz_v3.CO_TAZID
  WHERE weight > 0

  ORDER BY hts_year, hCO_TAZID
""").to_dataframe()

if debug: display(hts_hh_df)

# display results by county and subarea

if debug:
    # --- Build + display pivot by hSAID, hCO_FIPS (years as columns) ---
    hh_pivot_cfips = (
        hts_hh_df
        .groupby(['hts_year', 'hSAID', 'hCO_FIPS'], as_index=False)['hh_weight']
        .sum()
        .pivot_table(
            index=['hSAID', 'hCO_FIPS'],
            columns='hts_year',
            values='hh_weight',
            fill_value=0
        )
        .reset_index()
    )

    # remove the columns index name
    hh_pivot_cfips.columns.name = None

    # format only pivoted hh_weight columns (the year columns)
    year_cols = [c for c in hh_pivot_cfips.columns if isinstance(c, int)]
    display(hh_pivot_cfips.style.format({c: "{:,.0f}" for c in year_cols}))


    # --- Build + display pivot by hSAID only (years as columns) ---
    # --- Build pivot ---
    hh_pivot_subarea = (
        hts_hh_df
        .groupby(['hts_year', 'hSAID'], as_index=False)['hh_weight']
        .sum()
        .pivot_table(
            index=['hSAID'],
            columns='hts_year',
            values='hh_weight',
            fill_value=0
        )
        .reset_index()
    )

    # remove the columns index name
    hh_pivot_subarea.columns.name = None

    # --- Add TOTAL row ---
    year_cols = [c for c in hh_pivot_subarea.columns if isinstance(c, int)]

    total_row = (
        hh_pivot_subarea[year_cols]
        .sum()
        .to_frame()
        .T
    )

    total_row['hSAID'] = 'TOTAL'

    # align column order
    total_row = total_row[hh_pivot_subarea.columns]

    hh_pivot_subarea = pd.concat(
        [hh_pivot_subarea, total_row],
        ignore_index=True
    )

    # --- Display with formatting ---
    display(
        hh_pivot_subarea.style.format(
            {c: "{:,.0f}" for c in year_cols}
        )
    )

```

```{python}

# household travel survey (hts) trip data from bigquery
# make sure each year field names translate to same resulting names
# CO_FIPS and SUBAREA should be consistent no matter the TAZ version structure
# HBC college trips are produced as a special trip table, so remove here

hts_trip_df = client.query(f"""
  SELECT
    2023                          AS hts_year,
    CAST(hh_id AS STRING)         AS hh_id,
    PURP7_t                       AS trip_purpose_7,
    trip_weight                   AS trip_weight,
    pCO_FIPS                      AS pCO_FIPS,

    pSUBAREAID                    AS pSAID,
    aSUBAREAID                    AS aSAID

  WHERE
    PURP7_t != 'HBC' AND
    trip_weight > 0

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    2012                          AS hts_year,
    password                      AS hh_id,
    PURP7_t                       AS trip_purpose_7,
    weight                        AS trip_weight,
    p_CO_FIPS_v30                 AS pCO_FIPS,
    a_CO_FIPS_v30                 AS aCO_FIPS,

""").to_dataframe()
```

## Trip Production Rates

The sources of the data include the most recent Utah Household Travel Survey (HTS) from 2023, the HTS from 2012, and the base year model (BY 2023 Model).


```{python}
# calculate the total number of houses in the household travel survey in WF model area

# r = resident
# v = visitor
# a = all = resident + visitor
# t = trip
# tr = trip rate

wf_hh_sum_df = hts_hh_df[(hts_hh_df['hSAID']==1)].groupby(['hts_year'], as_index=False)['hh_weight'].agg('sum')
if debug:
    print('HTS WF Resident Households:')
    display(wf_hh_sum_df.style.format( {"hh_weight": "{:,.0f}"}))

# calculate thte total number of people in the household travel survey
wf_pop_sum_df = hts_person_df[(hts_person_df['hSAID']==1)].groupby(['hts_year'], as_index=False)['person_weight'].agg('sum')
if debug:
    print('HTS WF Resident Population:')
    display(wf_pop_sum_df.style.format( {"person_weight": "{:,.0f}"}))

# calculate the number of II productions in the Household Travel Survey
wf_r_ii_t_df = hts_trip_df[(hts_trip_df['hSAID']==1) & 
                           (hts_trip_df['pSAID']==1) &
                           (hts_trip_df['aSAID']==1) ]

wf_r_ii_t_sum_df = wf_r_ii_t_df.groupby(['hts_year'], as_index=False)['trip_weight'].agg('sum')
if debug:
    print('HTS WF Resident II Trips:')
    display(wf_r_ii_t_sum_df.style.format( {"trip_weight": "{:,.0f}"}))

# calculate rates
wf_r_tr_df = pd.merge(wf_r_ii_t_sum_df, wf_hh_sum_df, on=('hts_year'))
wf_r_tr_df['trips_per_hh'] = wf_r_tr_df['trip_weight'] / wf_r_tr_df['hh_weight']
wf_r_tr_df = pd.merge(wf_r_tr_df, wf_pop_sum_df, on=('hts_year'))
wf_r_tr_df['trips_per_person'] = wf_r_tr_df['trip_weight'] / wf_r_tr_df['person_weight']

if debug:
    print('HTS WF Resident II Trips Rates:')
    display(wf_r_tr_df.drop(columns=['trip_weight','person_weight','hh_weight']).style.format( {"trips_per_hh": "{:.2f}", "trips_per_person": "{:.2f}"}))

# calculate visitor II Trip Ends and add to resident II trips visitor has hh not in SUBAREAID 1
wf_v_ii_t_df = hts_trip_df[(hts_trip_df['hSAID'] != 1) &
                           (hts_trip_df['pSAID'] == 1) &
                           (hts_trip_df['aSAID'] == 1) ]

wf_v_ii_t_df

wf_v_ii_t_sum_df = wf_v_ii_t_df.groupby(['hts_year'], as_index=False)['trip_weight'].agg('sum')
if debug:
    print('HTS WF Visitor II Trips:')
    display(wf_v_ii_t_sum_df.style.format( {"trip_weight": "{:,.0f}"}))


# combine resident and visitor II trips
wf_a_ii_t_df = pd.concat([wf_r_ii_t_df, wf_v_ii_t_df])

wf_a_ii_t_sum_df = wf_a_ii_t_df.groupby(['hts_year'], as_index=False)['trip_weight'].agg('sum')
if debug:
    print('HTS WF Resident + Visitor II Trips:')
    display(wf_a_ii_t_sum_df.style.format( {"trip_weight": "{:,.0f}"}))


# calculate the number of IX productions in the Household Travel Survey
wf_a_ix_t_df = hts_trip_df[(hts_trip_df['pSAID'] == 1) &
                           (hts_trip_df['aSAID'] != 1) ].copy()

# change all purpose for ix trips to IX, since model doesn't breakdown ix by ii purposes
wf_a_ix_t_df['trip_purpose_7'] = 'IX'

wf_a_ix_t_sum_df = wf_a_ix_t_df.groupby(['hts_year'], as_index=False)['trip_weight'].agg('sum')

if debug:
    print('HTS WF Resident + Visitor IX Trips:')
    display(wf_a_ix_t_sum_df.style.format( {"trip_weight": "{:,.0f}"}))

# calculate the total number of production in Household Travel Survey
wf_a_ii_ix_t_df = pd.concat([wf_a_ii_t_df,wf_a_ix_t_df])
wf_a_ii_ix_t_sum_df = wf_a_ii_ix_t_df.groupby(['hts_year'], as_index=False)['trip_weight'].agg('sum')

if debug:
    print('HTS WF Resident + Visitor II and IX Productions:')
    display(wf_a_ii_ix_t_sum_df.style.format( {"trip_weight": "{:,.0f}"}))

# calculate rates
wf_a_ii_ix_tr_df = pd.merge(wf_a_ii_ix_t_sum_df, wf_hh_sum_df, on=('hts_year'))
wf_a_ii_ix_tr_df = pd.merge(wf_a_ii_ix_tr_df, wf_pop_sum_df, on=('hts_year'))
wf_a_ii_ix_tr_df['trips_per_hh'    ] = wf_a_ii_ix_tr_df['trip_weight'] / wf_a_ii_ix_tr_df['hh_weight'    ]
wf_a_ii_ix_tr_df['trips_per_person'] = wf_a_ii_ix_tr_df['trip_weight'] / wf_a_ii_ix_tr_df['person_weight']

if debug:
    print('HTS WF Resident II and IX Trip Rates (including visitor trips):')
    display(wf_a_ii_ix_tr_df.drop(columns=['trip_weight','person_weight','hh_weight']).style.format( {"trips_per_hh": "{:.2f}", "trips_per_person": "{:.2f}"}))
```

```{python}
#### prepare by purpose and by county ####

# aggregate by county
wf_pop_co_df = hts_person_df[(hts_person_df['hSAID']==1)].groupby(['hts_year','hCO_FIPS'], as_index=False)['person_weight'].agg('sum').rename(columns={'hCO_FIPS':'CO_FIPS'})
wf_hh_co_df = hts_hh_df[(hts_hh_df['hSAID']==1)].groupby(['hts_year','hCO_FIPS'], as_index=False)['hh_weight'].agg('sum').rename(columns={'hCO_FIPS':'CO_FIPS'})
wf_a_ii_ix_t_co_df = wf_a_ii_ix_t_df.groupby(['hts_year','pCO_FIPS','trip_purpose_7'], as_index=False)['trip_weight'].agg('sum').rename(columns={'pCO_FIPS':'CO_FIPS'})

# start prepping for rates
wf_a_ii_ix_tr_p_df = wf_a_ii_ix_t_co_df.copy()

# add total row for all purpose
totals_by_year = (wf_a_ii_ix_tr_p_df.groupby('hts_year', as_index=False).sum(numeric_only=True))
totals_by_year['trip_purpose_7'] = 'Total'
wf_a_ii_ix_tr_p_tot_df = pd.concat([wf_a_ii_ix_tr_p_df, totals_by_year],ignore_index=True)

# join with hh and pop
wf_a_ii_ix_tr_p_tot_df = pd.merge(wf_a_ii_ix_tr_p_tot_df, wf_hh_co_df, on=(['hts_year','CO_FIPS']))
wf_a_ii_ix_tr_p_tot_df = pd.merge(wf_a_ii_ix_tr_p_tot_df, wf_pop_co_df, on=(['hts_year','CO_FIPS']))

# add county name
wf_a_ii_ix_tr_p_tot_df = wf_a_ii_ix_tr_p_tot_df.merge(counties_df[['CO_FIPS','County']], on='CO_FIPS').drop(columns='CO_FIPS')

# add total row for all counties (region)
totals_by_year = (wf_a_ii_ix_tr_p_tot_df.groupby(['hts_year','trip_purpose_7'], as_index=False).sum(numeric_only=True))
totals_by_year['County'] = 'Region'
wf_a_ii_ix_tr_p_tot_reg_df = pd.concat([wf_a_ii_ix_tr_p_tot_df, totals_by_year],ignore_index=True)


# calculate rates
wf_a_ii_ix_tr_p_tot_reg_df['Trips per Household'] = wf_a_ii_ix_tr_p_tot_reg_df['trip_weight'] / wf_a_ii_ix_tr_p_tot_reg_df['hh_weight']
wf_a_ii_ix_tr_p_tot_reg_df['Trips per Person'] = wf_a_ii_ix_tr_p_tot_reg_df['trip_weight'] / wf_a_ii_ix_tr_p_tot_reg_df['person_weight']

wf_a_ii_ix_tr_p_tot_reg_df['Data Source'] = 'HTS ' + wf_a_ii_ix_tr_p_tot_reg_df['hts_year'].astype(str)
wf_a_ii_ix_tr_p_tot_reg_df.drop(columns=['hts_year'], inplace=True)
wf_a_ii_ix_tr_p_tot_reg_df.rename(columns={'trip_weight':'Trips',
                                           'trip_purpose_7':'Purpose',
                                           'hh_weight':'Households',
                                           'person_weight':'Population'
                                          }, inplace=True)

wf_a_ii_ix_tr_p_tot_reg_df.drop(columns=['Trips','Population','Households'], inplace=True)

if debug:
    print('HTS WF Resident II and IX Trip Rates (including visitor trips):')
    display(wf_a_ii_ix_tr_p_tot_reg_df.style.format( {"Trips per Household": "{:.2f}", "Trips per Person": "{:.2f}"}))

```



```{python}
# concat hts and mod and add total row.
# HTS rows have no calib_run (not tied to any one run) -- dropna=False keeps
# them as their own group instead of pandas silently dropping NaN groups.

trip_rates_county_purp_df = pd.concat([wf_a_ii_ix_tr_p_tot_reg_df, mod_p_se_county_reg_df])
if 'calib_run' not in trip_rates_county_purp_df.columns:
    trip_rates_county_purp_df['calib_run'] = None

# add total row for all purposes
totals_by_year = (
    trip_rates_county_purp_df
    .groupby(['Data Source', 'County', 'calib_run'], as_index=False, dropna=False)
    .sum(numeric_only=True)
)
totals_by_year['Purpose'] = 'All'
trip_rates_county_purp_df = pd.concat([trip_rates_county_purp_df, totals_by_year],ignore_index=True)

if debug:
    print('Model trip rates by County:')
    display(trip_rates_county_purp_df.style.format( {"Trips per Household": "{:.2f}", "Trips per Person": "{:.2f}"}))

```

```{python}
    )

    fig.update_traces(
        textfont_size=12,
        textangle=0,
        textposition="outside",
        cliponaxis=False,
        texttemplate='%{y:.2f}'
    )

    # Optional: clean up facet labels ("County=Salt Lake" → "Salt Lake")
    fig.for_each_annotation(lambda a: a.update(text=a.text.split("=")[-1]))

    fig
```

```{python}
# ======================================================================
# EXPORT TO OJS
# ======================================================================
# NaN (e.g. the HTS reference rows' calib_run) serializes to the bare
# token `NaN`, which is invalid JSON -- Quarto's OJS runtime parses this
# payload with plain JSON.parse(), so a stray NaN throws and silently
# aborts the whole ojs-define block (surfacing as "tripRates is not
# defined" client-side, not as a Python error). Swap NaN for None so it
# serializes as valid JSON `null`, which the OJS filters already expect.
tripRates = (
    trip_rates_county_purp_df
    .astype(object)
    .where(trip_rates_county_purp_df.notna(), None)
    .to_dict(orient="records")
)
ojs_define(tripRates=tripRates)

```

```{ojs}
//| label: fig-prod-hh
//| fig-cap: "Trip Generation Rates (II + IX) by Purpose"
//| echo: false

import {GroupedBarChart} from "@d3/grouped-bar-chart"
import {Swatches} from "@d3/color-legend"

{
  const container = html`
    <div style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:10px;"></div>
  `;

  // Controls
  const controls = html`
    <div style="display:flex; gap:16px; align-items:center; flex-wrap:wrap;"></div>
  `;
  controls.append(viewof countySelect);
  controls.append(viewof metricSelect);
  container.append(controls);

  // Reactive data -- always keep HTS reference rows (calib_run == null),
  // but only the selected calibration run's Model rows
  const filtered_data = tripRates
    .filter(d => d.County === countySelect)
    .filter(d => d.calib_run == null || d.calib_run === globalCalibRun)
    .map(d => ({ ...d, "Data Source": String(d["Data Source"]).trim() }));

  const purposeOrder = ["All","HBW","HBShp","HBOth","HBSch","NHBW","NHBNW","IX"];
  const purposes = purposeOrder.filter(p =>
    filtered_data.some(d => d.Purpose === p)
  );

  // Title
  container.append(html`
    <div style="font-size:18px; font-weight:600; margin-top:8px;">
      ${metricSelect} — ${countySelect} — ${globalCalibRun}
    </div>
  `);

  // Chart
  const chart = GroupedBarChart(filtered_data, {
    x: d => d.Purpose,
    y: d => d[metricSelect],
    z: d => d["Data Source"],
    xDomain: purposes,
    zDomain: ["HTS 2012", "HTS 2023", "Model"],
    colors: ["lightgray", themeTarget, themeModel],
    width: 900
  });

  chart.querySelectorAll("text").forEach(t => (t.style.fontSize = "18px"));
  container.append(chart);

  // Legend
  const color = d3.scaleOrdinal(
    ["HTS 2012", "HTS 2023", "BY 2023 Model"],
    ["lightgray", themeTarget, themeModel]
  );
  container.append(Swatches(color, { label: "Data Source" }));

  return container;
}
```
